ui.mcp.help.oauth: Browser sign-in for a remote server using OAuth. Tokens are managed by Toshy; this is not a replacement for arbitrary HTTP headers.

ui.mcp.help.sampling: Allow this server to ask Toshy to run the selected language model on its behalf.
ui.mcp.help.elicitation: Allow this server to request user input or browser authorization through Toshy.
ui.mcp.help.roots: Provide the current project roots to servers that request them. This describes context; it does not create a filesystem sandbox.
ui.mcp.help.apps: Enable interactive MCP App interfaces supplied by this server.
ui.mcp.help.transport: stdio launches a local process. Streamable HTTP connects to a remote HTTP endpoint. Legacy SSE supports older servers.
ui.mcp.help.command: Executable used to start a local stdio server, for example a Python interpreter or an MCP server command.
ui.mcp.help.args: Command arguments as a JSON array of strings. Each element is passed as one argument; do not enter a complete shell command here.
ui.mcp.help.url: Endpoint of a Streamable HTTP or Legacy SSE server. Unused for local stdio processes.
ui.mcp.help.timeout: Seconds allowed for connection/discovery and non-interactive requests. Time spent waiting for user interaction is excluded from a tool call timeout.
ui.mcp.help.env: Environment variables for the local server as a JSON object with string values. Unspecified keys keep their saved values. Values use the OS credential store or remain available until the core exits if that store is unavailable.
